paragraphs: (A baraita Tanna.) Hyman mentions him in a dispute with Issi ben Yehudah; [Sotah 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.16a.1-4) and [Sifrei Naso (10:1 in the linked edition, 53 in Hyman)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Bamidbar.10.1).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen parenthetical reads תניא דברייתא; it is read as a baraita-Tanna role label in this notice, not as a separate reported teaching event.

The Bavli quotes Issi ben Yehudah at [the end of 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.15b.17) and Issi ben Menachem on 16a. The linked Sifrei preserves the same arguments. Its English names Issi ben Yehudah, while its Hebrew has Issi ben Akavya. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=444&lang=en) cites both sages together and also points to Korach.
